objectives.description: Add per-phase-block iteration checking Verification Tier field with both punctuation conventions, log_warn per untiered phase, value validation, PLAN_METADATA exclusion comment
Update rules/plan-format-enforcement.md with per-phase field checklist and advisory enforcement note

approaches_tried.approach: Used bare ((var++)) as originally in log_warn per the plan's literal wording
approaches_tried.reason: Discovered via live testing that set -euo pipefail aborts the whole script on the very first 0->1 increment transition of any log_error/log_warn call, truncating validation to a single reported issue with no [PASS]/[FAIL] summary and wrong exit codes for warnings-only runs. Fixed by switching all three counters (errors, warnings, fixes) to the safe var=$((var+1)) assignment form.

deviations.description: Verify set -euo pipefail compatibility for log_warn's ((warnings++))
deviations.reason: The plan anticipated confirming an existing safe guard pattern already in use. Live testing showed no such guard existed anywhere in the script (log_error, log_warn, and log_fix were all bare ((var++)), all equally landmined) -- this was a pre-existing latent bug that silently truncated validation output for ANY plan with even one issue and produced wrong exit codes for warnings-only runs (exit 1 instead of the required exit 0). Fixed all three counter functions (not just log_warn) to the safe assignment form, since a partial fix limited to log_warn would still leave log_error and log_fix landmined and able to abort the script before the new per-phase loop is ever reached.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — fixed all three counter functions, not just log_warn, after live testing revealed the bug was pre-existing and would otherwise abort validation before the new per-phase loop runs)*
